title: ryedb MCP tools
description: Every tool the ryedb MCP server exposes. Generated by scripts/gen-contracts.mjs.

const.name: memory_brief
const.description: Return the current project memory brief (rules, decisions, known failures). Optionally focus on file paths.

const.name: error_search
const.description: Search recorded failures by text, signature or file path, with any known root cause and fix.

const.name: error_resolve
const.description: Record the root cause and fix for a failure signature. Stored as unconfirmed until a human or CI verifies it.

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: rule_propose
const.description: Propose a project rule (e.g. 'never edit generated files'). Stored as unconfirmed; it never blocks anything until a human verifies it.

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: rule_compile
const.description: Turn a rule into a blocking candidate. Give the rule text, a deny_pattern (JavaScript regex tested against the Bash command, or the file path for Edit/Write), 1+ must_fail examples it must match and 1+ must_pass examples it must not. RyeDB checks the pattern is safe and behaves as declared, then stores it as unconfirmed; it only blocks after a human verifies it. On failure you get exact errors: fix and call again.

must_fail.description: Commands or paths the rule must block

must_pass.description: Similar commands or paths the rule must allow

scope.description: glob limiting file rules, e.g. src/gen/**

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: decision_record
const.description: Record a design decision and why it was made.

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: task_set
const.description: Set the current task (replaces the previous one).

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: channel_post
const.description: RyeChannel: post a persistent message to another agent (to = role name or agent id) or broadcast (omit to). Recorded permanently.

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.name: channel_read
const.description: RyeChannel: read messages. With unread=true returns and acknowledges messages addressed to you.

agent.description: Your role name, e.g. 'main' or 'reviewer'. Self-declared.

const.description: Internal: receives agent lifecycle hook events. Not for agent use.
